Smooth window values and compute z-scores

Source: R/read_counts.R
smooth_windows.Rd

Smooth one metadata column of a named GRangesList without crossing genome gaps or large data gaps. Within each gap-free fragment holding at least min_wins non-NA windows, values are first averaged with a centred rolling mean of width 10 (zoo::rollapply(..., partial = TRUE)), then a smoothing spline is fitted to the rolling means against window midpoints. Genome-wide z-scores of both the rolling mean and the spline fit are added.

Usage

smooth_windows(
  wins_grl,
  mcols_id,
  gaps,
  min_wins = 20L,
  gap_th = 100000L,
  smooth_arg = list(spar = 0.2)
)

Arguments

wins_grl

Named GRangesList of genomic windows (names must equal the seqnames, e.g. "chr1").

mcols_id

Character scalar. Numeric metadata column to smooth, e.g. "raw_cn".

gaps

GRanges of genome gap regions.

min_wins

Minimum number of non-NA windows required to smooth a fragment (integer >= 2).

gap_th

Minimum gap size (bp) used to split smoothing fragments.

smooth_arg

List of extra arguments for stats::smooth.spline(), e.g. list(spar = 0.6), list(cv = TRUE) or list(df = 10). We use list(spar = 0.1).

Value

wins_grl with four added numeric metadata columns: {mcols_id}_ave (rolling mean), {mcols_id}_smoothed (spline fit), {mcols_id}_ave_z and {mcols_id}_smoothed_z (genome-wide z-scores; all NA if the SD is NA or 0). Windows outside smoothed fragments are NA.

Details

Only genome gaps of width >= gap_th are used as breaks; a data gap is declared between consecutive non-NA windows whose midpoints are >= gap_th apart.

Examples

set.seed(1)
gr <- GenomicRanges::GRanges("chr1", IRanges::IRanges(seq(1, by = 1000, length.out = 50),
                                                      width = 1000))
gr$raw_cn <- rnorm(50, 2, 0.2)
gaps <- GenomicRanges::GRanges("chr1", IRanges::IRanges(1, 1))
res <- smooth_windows(GenomicRanges::GRangesList(chr1 = gr), "raw_cn", gaps)
head(res$chr1)
